entity_input.label: Entity Input
entity_input.description: Reads one Home Assistant entity. Outputs its value and the raw sample with timestamps.

params.label: Sample Evidence
params.help: How the source integration writes states. changes_only: unchanged samples are not written, so new-sample arrival cannot be proven once the value is steady. reports_every_sample: every sample is written (last_reported advances even if unchanged). value_changes_each_sample: the value itself changes on every sample (e.g. a countdown).

params.label: Rest Values
params.help: Only for value_changes_each_sample: values at which the source can legitimately stop changing.

constant.label: Constant
constant.description: A fixed numeric or boolean value.

compare.label: Compare
compare.description: Compares A with B. Both inputs must use the same unit.

and.label: AND
and.description: True when all connected inputs are true.

or.label: OR
or.description: True when any connected input is true.

on_delay.label: On Delay
on_delay.description: Output turns true after the input has been true continuously for the delay. Resets when the input is false or invalid.

off_delay.label: Off Delay
off_delay.description: Output follows a true input and stays true for the delay after the input turns false. Resets when the input is invalid.

data_freshness.label: Data Freshness
data_freshness.description: Classifies a point as Fresh, Stale, Unavailable or Freshness Unknown from the arrival time of new samples (last_reported). Never uses the value-change time.

status_display.label: Status Display
status_display.description: Shows a value or status on the sheet. Monitoring only; drives nothing.

t3_read.label: T3000 Read
t3_read.description: Reads a controller point (IN, OUT or VAR). T3000 program sheets only.

t3_write.label: T3000 Write
t3_write.description: Writes a sandbox point on the controller (virtual VAR or OUT only). T3000 program sheets only.

t3_panel_in.label: Controller Inputs
t3_panel_in.description: Faceplate of the controller's physical inputs (IN1 to the model's last input) with labels and live values. A wire from a terminal reads that input. T3000 program sheets only.

t3_panel_out.label: Controller Outputs
t3_panel_out.description: Faceplate of the controller's physical outputs (digital then analog), its ports and status lights. A wire into a terminal writes that output. T3000 program sheets only.

divide.label: Divide
divide.description: A / B. Invalid in monitoring when B is 0; on a T3000 controller the last value is held.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Clamps the input between Low and High.

scale.label: Scale
scale.description: Linear scaling from the input range to the output range.

hysteresis.label: Hysteresis
hysteresis.description: Turns on at or above On Above, off at or below Off Below, and holds between them.

select.label: Select
select.description: Outputs True Value when Select is true, otherwise False Value.

pi.label: PI Loop
pi.description: PI controller with anti-windup. Reverse action is for heating (output rises when PV is below SP). When Enable is false the output goes to Output Min and the integral resets.

cb_unmapped.label: Unmapped Code
cb_unmapped.description: A program line that could not be represented exactly as blocks. It is shown for reference and does not run.

cb_local_read.label: Local Variable
cb_local_read.description: A named local variable of a T3000 program, as it was at the start of the scan.

cb_local_write.label: Local Variable Set
cb_local_write.description: The value a T3000 program leaves in a named local variable at the end of the scan.

xor.label: XOR
xor.description: True when exactly one of A and B is true.

latch.label: SR Latch
latch.description: Set turns the output on and it stays on until Reset. Reset wins when both are true. Resets when an input is not valid.

edge.label: Edge Pulse
edge.description: Outputs a pulse of the given length when the input changes (rising, falling or both).

counter.label: Counter
counter.description: Counts rising edges of the input. Reset (optional) sets the count to 0.

average.label: Moving Average
average.description: Average of the good input values seen during the last window.

rate.label: Rate of Change
rate.description: Change of the input per minute, measured over the window.

ramp.label: Rate Limit
ramp.description: Follows the input but moves no faster than the rate (units per minute). Starts at the first good value.

range_check.label: Range Check
range_check.description: Out of Range is true when the input is below Low or above High. In Range is the opposite.

alarm.label: Alarm
alarm.description: Raises an alarm when the condition stays true for the delay. Shown on the sheet; a sheet running in Home Assistant notifies. Monitoring only; drives nothing.

modbus_read.label: Modbus Read
modbus_read.description: Reads a register or coil of any Modbus RTU device on the controller's RS-485 port (port set to Modbus Master). T3000 program sheets only.

modbus_write.label: Modbus Write
modbus_write.description: Writes a holding register or coil of any Modbus RTU device on the controller's RS-485 port (port set to Modbus Master). T3000 program sheets only.

heating_valve.label: Heating Valve
heating_valve.description: PI heating valve (reverse acting) on a supply or discharge temperature. Disabled: closed. Freeze input: 100 % open.

cooling_valve.label: Cooling Valve
cooling_valve.description: PI cooling valve (direct acting) on a supply or discharge temperature, locked out below an outdoor temperature. Disabled or locked out: closed.

economizer.label: Economizer
economizer.description: Outdoor air damper: PI on mixed air temperature when outdoor air is cooler than return and below the high limit; minimum position otherwise; minimum position on low mixed air; closed with the fan off.

oa_reset.label: Outdoor Air Reset
oa_reset.description: Setpoint reset by outdoor temperature: a straight line between two points, held at the end values.

hx_steam.label: Heat Exchanger
hx_steam.description: Steam or hot water heat exchanger: outdoor air reset setpoint, heating allowed below an outdoor temperature (with hysteresis), pump command with post-run, PI valve enabled after the pump is proven for a delay.

lead_lag_pumps.label: Lead/Lag Pumps
lead_lag_pumps.description: Two pumps: the lead runs when enabled; if it does not prove within the delay it is failed (held until disabled) and the other pump runs. Both failed raises an alarm.

fan_proof.label: Fan with Proof
fan_proof.description: Fan start/stop with status proof: no proof within the delay fails the fan (it stops) until the command goes off.

freeze_protection.label: Freeze Protection
freeze_protection.description: Low limit (freezestat): temperature below the limit for the delay trips, held until Reset.
